thread.empty: No messages in this thread yet.
thread.older.offline: Earlier messages cannot be loaded right now.
thread.sys.task_failed.review_rounds: Task {task} stopped after repeated failed reviews.
thread.sys.session_replaced: {ai} started a new session from the task notes.
thread.sys.no_secretary: This group has no secretary AI.
thread.sys.group_paused: {by} paused the group. All its AIs stop for now.
thread.sys.group_resumed: {by} resumed the group. Its AIs carry on.
thread.sys.rate_limited: {ai} is out of quota until {time}, then carries on.
thread.sys.rounds_limit: {task} is paused: the AIs went {n} rounds without a person. Reply in its thread to carry on.
thread.sys.preempted: {by} jumped the queue. {task} is paused and carries on afterwards.
thread.reply.hint: Write in {task}'s thread, @ an AI to reach it
thread.reply.resumes: Sending this carries the task on.
thread.reply.silent: @ an AI if one should answer. Otherwise this just stays in the thread.
thread.reply.paused: {task} is paused: its AIs get this once it resumes.
thread.reply.failed: {task} is stopped: its AIs get this once it resumes.
